 Key points
 Level 4 basic pay starts at ₹25,500. DA went up from 60% to 63% from 1 July 2026, which adds ₹16,065 a month. 
 Gross pay at the first cell is ₹55,083 a month in an X-class city such as Delhi. 
 In Y-class cities on the Transport Allowance list, such as Jaipur or Lucknow, it is ₹52,533. In other Y-class cities it is ₹49,599, and in Z-class towns ₹47,049. 
 The armed forces and railway staff get DA under their own ministries' orders. State, PSU and bank staff have their own rates. 
 Advertisement
 A central government employee at the first cell of Pay Level 4 now gets ₹55,083 a month gross in an X-class city such as Delhi, Mumbai or Chennai. That is basic pay plus Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA) and Transport Allowance.
 Level 4 covers posts such as Postal Assistant, Sorting Assistant and Tax Assistant.
 How the ₹55,083 is made up
 Part of pay How it is worked out Amount 
 Basic pay First cell of Level 4 ₹25,500 
 DA 63% of basic ₹16,065 
 HRA 30% of basic in an X-class city ₹7,650 
 Transport Allowance ₹3,600, plus 63% DA on it ₹5,868 
 Gross pay ₹55,083 
 The Finance Ministry’s order of 29 October 2026 raised DA from 60% to 63% of basic pay, from 1 July 2026. DA stays a separate part of pay. It is not added to basic.
 Your city decides two allowances
 HRA depends on your city’s class: 30% of basic in X-class cities, 20% in Y-class cities and 10% in Z-class towns.
 Transport Allowance follows a different list of cities. For Levels 3 to 8, it is ₹3,600 a month in the cities on that list and ₹1,800 elsewhere, with DA paid on top. The list has every X-class city. It also has these Y-class cities: Patna, Surat, Kochi, Kozhikode, Indore, Nagpur, Jaipur, Coimbatore, Ghaziabad, Kanpur and Lucknow.
 Where you are posted HRA Transport Allowance Gross pay 
 X-class city, such as Delhi ₹7,650 ₹5,868 ₹55,083 
 Y-class city on the list, such as Jaipur ₹5,100 ₹5,868 ₹52,533 
 Other Y-class city, such as Bhopal ₹5,100 ₹2,934 ₹49,599 
 Z-class town ₹2,550 ₹2,934 ₹47,049 
 These are gross figures at the first cell. NPS, CGHS, CGEGIS and income tax are cut from them. Basic pay moves up one cell with each yearly increment. Check any cell with the 7th/8th CPC pay matrix , and the DA with the DA calculator .
 When Transport Allowance is not paid
 If the office gives you government transport.
 For a calendar month you spend wholly on leave, on tour or under suspension.
 Staff who are visually impaired, orthopaedically disabled, hearing impaired or have a spinal deformity get double the normal rate.
 Who these rates cover
 They cover civilian central government employees, including civilians paid from the defence budget. For the armed forces and railway employees, the Ministry of Defence and the Ministry of Railways issue separate orders. State government, PSU and bank staff have their own DA and HRA rates.
 The same working for Level 3 is here .
 Source: Ministry of Finance, Department of Expenditure — DA O.M. No. 1/2(i)/2026-E.II(B), 29 October 2026; Transport Allowance O.M. No. 21/5/2017-E.II(B), 7 July 2017, with its Annexure of cities; HRA O.M. No. 2/5/2017-E.II(B), 7 July 2017.

 Critical AdSense behaviour: adsbygoogle.push({}) does NOT bind to
 a specific . It says "process the next unbound in DOM
 order." So if you push N times, AdSense binds the first N 
 slots it finds.
 Live investigation (2026-05-29) showed the right sidebar still
 loading late on indianpaycalculator.in. DOM order of :
 1. LEFT sidebar (in aside.ad-sidebar-left)
 2-5. Display banners (4× AdBanner inside page content)
 6. RIGHT sidebar (in aside.ad-sidebar-right, after main slot)
 7. Mobile anchor (StickyAnchorAd at body end)
 Previously this script pushed twice (one per sidebar). Those 2
 pushes bound LEFT + Display#1, NOT LEFT + RIGHT. The other 5
 slots only got bound as AdBanner.client:visible islands hydrated
 on scroll — meaning the right sidebar was bound 6th, after the
 user scrolled past every in-page banner. That's the "right side
 opens very late" complaint.
 Fix: push once per SSR'd ad slot. AdSense binds them all in DOM
 order at body parse end — no React hydration wait, no scroll-to-
 view wait. Subsequent React useEffect pushes (from AdUnit /
 StickyAnchorAd) become no-ops since the AdUnit effect skips when
 data-adsbygoogle-status is already set. --> component was removed 2026-05-29 to eliminate the
 duplicate-anchor conflict where both the manual slot 4961033893 and
 Auto Anchor would compete on mobile, causing one to fail to fill. -->
